recipe.visualDefinition: A split-composition layout featuring a full-body portrait on the right and massive, vertically stacked block lettering on the left that spans the entire height of the frame. The portrait is set against a hazy, smoke-filled studio background, while the typography uses high-contrast color bands.
coreVisualRelationships: Vertical text blocks acting as a structural pillar on the left third
Subject on the right third looking directly at the viewer
Atmospheric smoke softening the background behind the subject
Horizontal color bands in the text aligning with the vertical stack
coreInvariants: Vertical orientation of the primary display text
Split composition between graphic type and photographic subject
Muted, earthy color palette for the portrait side

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Full-body male figure, standing, positioned in the right two-thirds of the frame, medium-large scale.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The massive vertical lettering on the left edge.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the top-left vertical text, moves down the stack, then shifts right to the subject's face and follows the body down.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The smoke-filled background provides a textured negative space that separates the subject from the graphic elements.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Muted browns and greys in the photographic area.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep red and white in the typographic blocks.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Ochre/orange and dark forest green in the top and bottom bands.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the graphic left-side; low saturation and atmospheric haze on the right-side.

letterConstructionRules: Characters are cropped by the left edge of the frame
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters are flattened to fill rectangular color blocks
Internal counters are minimized to maintain block-like appearance
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Extreme contrast between ultra-bold geometric blocks and distressed traditional slab serifs.
graphicDevices: Rounded pill-shape container for small metadata text

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary weight and blocky structure for stretching.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A full-body portrait of a person in streetwear standing in a hazy, smoke-filled studio. The left third of the image should be reserved for solid vertical color bands (Ochre, Red, White, Red, Ochre). A dark green horizontal bar should sit at the top right.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add ultra-bold, horizontally stretched sans-serif letters vertically down the left color bands. Add a distressed slab-serif title in white on the top-right green bar.

verificationChecks: Is the text on the left stretched horizontally?
Is there a visible smoke effect behind the subject?
Are the color bands clearly defined?

adjustableVariables: Stretch intensity of the vertical text

mustAchieve: Legible but highly stylized vertical type

postGenerationChecks: Check that vertical letters are correctly stacked
Ensure the smoke doesn't obscure the subject's face
Verify the color bands align with the letter heights
Confirm the top-right text has a stamped texture
recipe.reuseFormula: Vertical Block Type + Atmospheric Portrait + Color Banding = Urban Music Aesthetic
